newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end higher on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose at Thursday's close on selective blue-chip buying by individuals prompted by short-covering by big investors, dealers said.
"A lot of retail investors jumped in as the index rose amid short-covering by major players," dealer Anwer Shakeel said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 27.92 points, or 1.81 percent, to close at 1,571.10. Losers led gainers 158 to 127.
PTCL rose 0.55 rupees to 29 and Pakistan State Oil 5.0 to 297. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
